prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Turn Hokusai's *Great Wave off Kanagawa* into an original low-poly 3D wallpaper with gentle motion, plus a record of boats and mountain.

[action] Built `./scene/index.html` as a single hand-coded file, importing only `three@0.170.0` and Google Fonts. Reconstructed the print with extruded flat-shaded meshes: the clawed curling crest from the left, foam lobes, comma-shaped foam curls and spray, three *oshiokuri-bune* with rowers and oars, layered foreground swells, and a snow-capped Mount Fuji low at centre-right, on a cream-to-grey shader sky with paper grain and a vertical cartouche. Wrote `./result.json`. Opened and visually inspected the render at 1280×800 and forced reloads to defeat cache.

[result] Files delivered:
- `scene/index.html` — the print's composition, Prussian/indigo palette and subjects rebuilt in code; print is not used as a texture. Motion: wave swell, bobbing boats, drifting spray, swaying foam, slow camera parallax. Verified animation loop running (window frame counter 313 → 374 over 600 ms) and no external asset besides the permitted CDN/font origins.
- `result.json` — `"boats": 3`, `"mountain": "Mount Fuji"`, plus source/palette/assumptions.

Assumptions: the three visible *oshiokuri-bune* are the boats counted; Fuji is named in English with its Japanese form kept as an extra field; the cartouche reproduces the public-domain title text for recognition.

What I found and how I know it is right: the image is Hokusai's *The Great Wave off Kanagawa*, identified by its clawed indigo wave, three wooden boats and Fuji at the horizon. I know by direct visual reading of `print.jpg` and by screenshotting my own rebuilt scene, comparing silhouette, palette, three boats and Fuji placement. Browser tab closed.
